# volt.rs

> volt.rs is a React framework with a Rust server. It uses the Next.js App Router conventions (app/ directory, layouts, metadata, next/link and next/navigation compatible APIs) with server-side rendering, server actions, loaders and API routes written in Rust. React renders on the server inside QuickJS, the client hydrates and navigates without reloads, and Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui work out of the box.

Key facts:
- Create an app: `npm create volt-rs@latest my-app`. Dev: `npm run dev`. Build: `npm run build`. Run: `npm run start`.
- Pages are React components in `app/` (App Router) or `pages/` (Pages Router, with `getServerSideProps`, `getStaticProps` and `next/router`). Server code is Rust in `server/main.rs` using the `voltrs` crate.
- `#[loader("/route")]` returns the page `data` prop. `#[action]` functions are called from React via the generated `@volt/api` module. `#[get("/api/x")]` defines JSON endpoints.
- `#[model]` structs are serialized with camelCase fields and exported as TypeScript interfaces.
- Pages stream Suspense boundaries from the server (`use(promise)`, `lazy`, `next/dynamic`); `loading.tsx` shows at once on client navigation.
- Not supported: React Server Components, async components, `"use server"`, parallel and intercepting routes.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS Modules (`*.module.css`, `*.module.scss`), Sass, PostCSS, and `next/font/google` / `next/font/local` (also `volt-rs/font/*`).

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, project structure, dev and production builds
- [Routing](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/routing.md): file conventions, layouts, dynamic segments, Link, navigation hooks
- [Pages Router](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/pages-router.md): pages/, _app, _document, getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths, next/router
- [Data](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/data.md): models, loaders, actions, forms, API routes, Ctx, state, middleware, errors
- [Metadata and SEO](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/metadata-seo.md): metadata API, JSON-LD, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt
- [Styling and assets](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/styling.md): Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, CSS Modules, Sass, PostCSS, fonts, images, scripts
- [Static generation](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/static-generation.md): generateStaticParams, dynamicParams, getStaticPaths, ISR, revalidate_path, volt export, base_path, trailing_slash
- [Configuration](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): volt.toml, environment variables
- [Deployment](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): build output, Docker, caching
- [Coming from Next.js](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-nextjs.md): compatibility table and migration
- [Architecture](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): how rendering, bundling and the type bridge work
- [CLI](https://github.com/redstone-md/volt.rs/blob/main/docs/cli.md): volt commands
